label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to host variable, which is used in URL construction for outbound connection. Although there is a check calling resolveHost(host) followed by isNonPublicAddress(), this validation is insufficient: (1) It only blocks specific IP classes (loopback, site-local, link-local, any-local) but misses RFC 1918 private ranges (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x), (2) DNS rebinding attacks remain possible between resolution and connection, (3) The resolved sink value at line 43 is http://+host+/v1 where host=param=user input. Attacker-controlled hostname reaches the network sink.

evidence.note: User input param flows to host, then to URL connection sink at L43
isNonPublicAddress only checks limited IP classes, missing RFC 1918 ranges
